questions.prompt:
Tables:
customers - Columns: customer_id (PK), customer_name, city
orders - Columns: order_id (PK), customer_id (FK), order_date, amount

Write a SQL query to show how many orders each customer has placed, INCLUDING customers who have placed no orders (they should show a count of 0). Display customer_id, customer_name and order_count.
questions.referenceAnswer:
SELECT c.customer_id, c.customer_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM customers c
LEFT JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name;

questions.prompt:
Table: products
Columns: product_id (PK), product_name, category, price

Write a SQL query to list all the distinct product categories, sorted alphabetically.

Table: orders
Columns: order_id (PK), customer_id, order_date, amount

Write a SQL query to find the top 3 customers by their total order amount. Display customer_id and total amount, highest first.
questions.referenceAnswer:
SELECT customer_id, SUM(amount) AS total_amount
FROM orders
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY total_amount DESC
LIMIT 3;
